description: Private nodeProtocol 2 lifecycle data/scenarios. No runtime adapter is installed or exercised by this documentation fixture. Each scenario has fresh seeded state. fixtureEvent names are deterministic controls for future authenticated component harnesses, not wire operations. Replacements are JSON pointers; header idempotencyKey follows the replaced preparationId/turnId/stopId. correlation:fresh changes requestId/streamId without changing operation identity. Expectations are future assertions, not measured results. sourceMetadata manifest strings use checkpointFormat 1 typed field order; metadataValidationCases are prepared raw JSON inputs for strict static parsing. metadataBoundaryCases specify numeric limits, not successful runtime admission. Synthetic Git OIDs do not establish object existence. checkpointReadExamples and checkpointReadScenarios are separate prepared private registration/Git data, with no runtime harness execution. The registration receipt is not authority or proof of received objects.
